title: 14-BCV-011 - Door release hardware
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide, as stated by the STANDATA)
code_edition: Alberta Building Code 2014 and Alberta Fire Code 2014; document also cites National Building Code of Canada 2015 as context

facts.text: The catalogue marks 14-BCV-011 withdrawn. The PDF applies to doors in Group B, Division 2 and Division 3 occupancies and cites ABC Sentence 3.4.6.16 and ABC 3.2.4.8.(4).
facts.locator: Official 2014 catalogue, row 14-BCV-011; 14-BCV-011 PDF, pp.1-2, CODE REFERENCES and APPLICATION

facts.text: The historical magnetic-lock alternative requires a fire alarm and sprinklers, specified unlock signals and manual reset, signage, audible/visual bypass monitoring, and emergency lighting; one optional extra release device is allowed.
